open_bugs.title: Map surface renders completely black on page load — Leaflet getSize() returns (0,0) on init
open_bugs.classification: CODE DEFECT — NOT ENVIRONMENTAL. CARTO CDN tile images ARE loading HTTP 200 (confirmed in this live session). The black canvas is caused by Leaflet initialising before NiceGUI has resolved container dimensions. Leaflet reports getSize()={x:0,y:0} on init. Compound issue: Tailwind CSS v4 base style 'img { max-width: 100% }' overrides Leaflet tile inline 'width: 256px', clamping tile render width to 0px because a 0-width ancestor is cached. Marker icon images have same 0px width problem.

root_cause.primary: map.invalidateSize() is not called after NiceGUI layout mount completes. Leaflet reads container size at JS bootstrap time when container is 0x0.
root_cause.secondary: Tailwind CSS v4 @layer base { img { max-width: 100% } } overrides Leaflet's .leaflet-tile { max-width: none } rule for all elements. When max-width: 100% resolves against a 0-width ancestor, tile and marker-icon images render at 0px width permanently.
root_cause.js_evidence: window._htMapInstance.getSize() === {x:0, y:0} on fresh load; after manual invalidateSize() returns {x:1642, y:722}
root_cause.css_evidence: Computed cssWidth on .leaflet-tile === '0px' despite inline style 'width: 256px'. Tailwind rule: 'img, video { max-width: 100%; height: auto }' confirmed in document.styleSheets.

open_bugs.action_required: Route to QA-Fixer. Fix 1: schedule map.invalidateSize() after NiceGUI layout renders (ui.timer or equivalent). Fix 2: add CSS rule '#ht-map-canvas .leaflet-tile, #ht-map-canvas .leaflet-marker-icon { max-width: none; }' to prevent Tailwind base styles from interfering.

resolved_bugs.resolution: CONFIRMED FIXED AND LIVE-VERIFIED — side panel opened correctly on marker click in this session. _set_drawer_open correctly toggles both set_visibility() and the CSS class ht-map-drawer-open.
